about.headline: Three decades of showing up.
body: Bedrock started in 1992 with two pickup trucks, a concrete mixer, and a refusal to cut corners.
We self-perform our structural, concrete, and carpentry work, which means the people accountable are on our payroll.

testimonials.quote: Bedrock hit a 14-month schedule on a project everyone else padded to 18. No drama, no change-order games.
testimonials.author: Dana Whitfield

testimonials.quote: They walked us through every risk before we signed. When the unexpected showed up underground, they already had a plan.
testimonials.author: Marcus Reyes

contact.headline: Let's talk about what you're building.
